policies.name: GoI Legal Metrology: Mandatory MRP & Unit Sale Price Cap
policies.condition: Competitor Listing Price > Declared Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
policies.action: Flag criminal offense under Legal Metrology Sec 36; auto-freeze listing and trigger legal compliance notice
policies.authority: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution (GoI)
policies.penaltyNotice: Sec 36 Penalty: Fine up to ₹1,00,000 / Takedown / Director Liability

policies.name: CCPA Anti-Predatory Flash Sale & Fake Urgency Ban
policies.condition: Flash sale discount > 35% with artificial scarcity countdown or drip pricing
policies.action: Log dark pattern violation under CCPA Guidelines 2023; alert Pricing Review Committee
policies.penaltyNotice: Class Action Inquiry & Penalty up to ₹10,00,000 under Sec 18

policies.name: CCI Section 4: Deep Discounting Below Landed COGS Prohibition
policies.condition: Marketplace price undercut > 12% below verified distributor landed cost
policies.action: Block predatory undercut; file antitrust violation log with compliance audit trail
policies.penaltyNotice: Antitrust investigation & penalty up to 10% of global turnover

policies.name: CBIC GST Rule 138: Mandatory E-Way Bill Consignment Threshold
policies.condition: Single order consignment value >= ₹50,000 across state borders
policies.action: Require automated Part-A E-Way Bill generation before regional dark store dispatch
policies.authority: Central Board of Indirect Taxes & Customs (CBIC) & GST Council
policies.penaltyNotice: 100% tax penalty & vehicle/consignment seizure under CGST Sec 129

policies.name: MeitY / BIS CRO Scheme: Compulsory Registration Order for Electronics
policies.condition: Electronics catalog item missing verified Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) R-Number
policies.action: Halt syndication immediately; flag uncertified import to legal compliance team
policies.penaltyNotice: Seizure of goods and fine up to ₹5,00,000 under BIS Act, 2016

policies.name: Maharashtra E-Commerce Urban Logistics & Night Delivery Mandate
policies.condition: Quick-commerce delivery operating 11:00 PM - 06:00 AM without BMC commercial permit
policies.action: Enforce nighttime decibel & routing curbs; verify BMC 24/7 establishment license
policies.authority: Government of Maharashtra & Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC)
policies.penaltyNotice: Shop & Establishment Act closure notice & fine

policies.name: Karnataka Platform Gig Workers Social Security Act Compliance
policies.condition: Quick-commerce delivery fee missing mandatory ₹5 state welfare fund contribution
policies.action: Auto-credit mandatory worker welfare cess per order; verify Bengaluru dark store rider registry
policies.authority: Department of Labour, Government of Karnataka
policies.penaltyNotice: Labour Commissioner penalty & platform license suspension

policies.name: Delhi Motor Vehicle Aggregator & Delivery Provider EV Mandate
policies.condition: Delivery fleet non-EV vehicle ratio exceeds 20% during winter GRAP Stage IV
policies.action: Restrict non-EV delivery dispatch routes; switch automated assignment to 100% electric bikes
policies.authority: Transport Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
policies.penaltyNotice: Delhi Motor Vehicles Act fine up to ₹1,00,000 & vehicle impound

policies.name: Tamil Nadu Packaged Commodities Bilingual Price & Origin Mandate
policies.condition: Packaged retail unit missing Tamil & English dual-language MRP & Net Quantity declaration
policies.action: Require dual-language packaging verification before Chennai & Coimbatore hub dispatch
policies.authority: Department of Labour & Legal Metrology, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.penaltyNotice: Legal Metrology confiscation notice under TN Rules

policies.name: Gujarat Commercial Tax & GIFT City SEZ Customs Reconciliation
policies.condition: Bonded warehouse dispatch entering Domestic Tariff Area (DTA) without cleared IGST
policies.action: Hold automated dispatch for Bill of Entry (BOE) verification by Gujarat Commercial Tax Dept
policies.authority: State Tax Department, Govt of Gujarat & GIFT City SEZ Authority
policies.penaltyNotice: Customs Act Sec 111 confiscation & fiscal duty penalty

policies.name: Telangana E-Commerce Fulfillment & Dark Store Safety Ordinance
policies.condition: Order processing velocity > 220 orders/hr exceeding municipal fire safety capacity
policies.action: Throttle rapid dispatch SLA to safe 15-minute operational limit; alert GHMC safety liaison
policies.authority: Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) & Fire Services Dept
policies.penaltyNotice: Municipal health trade license review & safety stop-work notice

policies.name: West Bengal Directorate of Consumer Affairs Festive Price Surveillance
policies.condition: Festive price markup > 10% above 30-day pre-festival baseline
policies.action: Flag price gouging breach; clamp automated repricing to Kolkata regional average
policies.authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of West Bengal
policies.penaltyNotice: WB Consumer Dispute Forum investigation & corrective price order

policies.name: Uttar Pradesh High-Value Goods Digital Invoicing Verification
policies.condition: High-value smartphone or laptop dispatch without dynamic QR invoice verification
policies.action: Attach digital dispatch receipt with verified GSTIN e-invoice QR code to courier parcel
policies.authority: Commercial Tax Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
policies.penaltyNotice: Vehicle interception & Sec 129 penalty in UP highway checkpoints
